title: MetaCloud configuration
description: Root metacloud.yaml for meta init / meta validate.

git_branch.description: VCS branch used by Terraform Cloud workspaces. When omitted, the repository default branch is used.

git_enabled.description: Whether the Terraform Cloud module manages the VCS OAuth connection (default: true). Set false when VCS integration is managed externally.

vscode_yaml_schema.description: Set to true to let meta init write VS Code/Cursor yaml.schemas settings into .vscode/settings.json (off by default).

aws.description: AWS credentials variable set settings (terraform-cloud driver only). Credential values always come from the meta exec session.

enabled.description: Set to false when the AWS credentials variable set is managed outside this setup.

variable_set_name.description: Name of the AWS credentials variable set (module default: aws_credentials).

tfe_token_variable_set.description: TFE token variable set settings (terraform-cloud driver only).

enabled.description: Set to false when the TFE token variable set is managed outside this setup.

name.description: Name of the TFE token variable set (module default: tfe-token).
